description: Konstantin Löffler, Karlo Hainsch and Thorsten Burandt at TU Berlin publish supplementary inputs and outputs for Open ENTRANCE Deliverable D3.2. The source identifies GENeSYS-MOD version v3.1-oE and states that its GAMS model files are included. Ten ZIP descriptors cover spreadsheet inputs, GDX, CSV and spreadsheet results, dispatch results and IAMC-format outputs. The variants labelled 244 and 484 are preserved without inferring their numerical meaning. This is one energy-system scenario bundle linked to the deliverable on European low-carbon futures at country, regional and local levels. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is that exact countries, scenario horizons, time steps and internal archive contents are not established by the inspected metadata. The existing GENeSYS-MOD family record provides model context. No output file, model source or deliverable body was read, and scenario outcomes were not checked.
